brief:
Ben Jennings, a cartoonist for The Guardian, has published a work addressing the Gaza ceasefire, according to the outlet. The cartoon appears to critique or interrogate aspects of the ceasefire arrangement, suggested by Jennings' use of quotation marks around the term.

The work reflects ongoing scrutiny of ceasefire negotiations and their implementation in Gaza, a territory that has faced sustained conflict.
title: Cartoonist Ben Jennings questions Gaza ceasefire terms
